about: Get ready for a magical journey filled with festive cheer in Holiday Eye Spy, the ultimate spot-the-difference game designed to bring joy, challenge, and holiday spirit to players of all ages! Step into a cozy winter wonderland, where each pair of beautiful, hand-drawn images hides subtle differences waiting to be discovered. Can you find them all before time runs out?

Holiday Eye Spy is not just any ordinary puzzle game—it's a holiday-themed adventure that will test your observational skills while immersing you in the warm, heartwarming sights of the holiday season. Whether it's a twinkling Christmas tree, a festive snow globe, or a cozy fireplace, every level presents you with two almost identical images—but with sneaky little differences hidden in plain sight.
🔍 Your goal? Spot all the differences between the two images before your time runs out! The faster you find them, the higher your score!
One-time licence fee to download to multiple PS4 systems. Sign in to PlayStation is not required to use this on your primary PS4, but is required for use on other PS4 systems.
